Tottenham press conference LIVE - De Zerbi on Porro, Kulusevski, Richarlison and Marbella training

The Tottenham Hotspur head coach is speaking to the media ahead of Monday night's Premier League match against Coventry City

Tottenham Hotspur head coach Roberto De Zerbi is holding his press conference ahead of the Premier League game against Coventry City

Add to preferred sources

Comments

Spurs

Alasdair Gold Tottenham Hotspur correspondent

Updated 11:18, 18 Oct 2026

Roberto De Zerbi is holding his press conference on Sunday ahead of Tottenham's Premier League game against Coventry City on Monday evening.

Spurs have returned from a warm-weather training camp in Marbella this week as De Zerbi looked to help them bond together as a group after bringing in 10 new faces during the summer transfer window. Despite those big changes and around £300million spent, the north London club sit bottom of the early Premier League table without a win to their name.

Now Tottenham welcome Frank Lampard's in-form promoted Coventry side, knowing that they have to start winning soon and put their wretched home record behind them, otherwise they will get embroiled in another relegation battle.

De Zerbi will deliver updates on the fitness of Pedro Porro and Dejan Kulusevski and he could also be asked about Richarlison , with the Brazilian vocal on social media about his treatment at Spurs.

Our Tottenham reporter Alasdair Gold is among those putting the questions to De Zerbi ahead of the game against Coventry. Scroll down for his latest updates from the press conference at Hotspur Way.
